2287987399cea0635adae3f67ffe82fb10db2787.summary: This is an archived copy of the Kubernetes API reference documentation for v1.19. It describes resource types, API groups, and read, write, and watch operations. It contains no threat activity, actors, malware, vulnerabilities, incidents, or indicators, so it is not a threat report.

2226a04ca0f82b7141074adfeff8c339bf778b7f.summary: Trend Micro research on attackers exploiting public-proof-of-concept flaws in Apache HTTP Server, Atlassian Confluence, F5 BIG-IP, VMware vCenter and Oracle WebLogic to deploy Monero cryptocurrency miners. Miner scripts and binaries were hosted on GitHub and Netlify, and both platforms took down the accounts after being informed. The miners target both Windows and Linux hosts and include persistence and removal of competing miners.

hedges: The report believes more servers remain unpatched and exposed to these exploits, based on attempt frequency.
The report says the attackers can appear almost unsophisticated, given their use of public proofs of concept, but still operate regularly.
The report says GitHub and Netlify abuse will continue, and CDN factors will likely change attacker behaviour, including for unrelated attacks.
The report says that where IDS/IPS is in place, network artifacts will not contribute to detection, and IP reputation services will not flag these platforms.
